A nasal hum. Hold it for two counts when noon or meem carries a shadda or a sukun.
Merging with a hum: noon meets one of ي ن م و and the sound slides into the next letter.
Merging without a hum: noon meets ل or ر and is swallowed completely.
Flipping: noon followed by ب turns into a meem sound with a hum.
Hiding: noon followed by one of fifteen letters is half said, with a hum.
Clear: noon followed by ء ه ع ح غ خ is said plainly, with no hum.
The bouncing sound. When these letters have a sukun, the sound bounces a little.
Lengthening: stretch the vowel for two to six counts.
